[LADP.2.1.1] Adapter-published schemas representing observed
state must declare `scope ambient` per [LSCP.2.5]. The compiler
rejects rule-side `emit` and `retract` actions targeting ambient
schemas, preventing rules from spoofing adapter-observed facts.
Rules wanting to trigger downstream effects emit a
non-ambient request schema (e.g. `LightRequest`) and let the
adapter respond.
